Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering , or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in NOC, Network Operations, or Network Engineering roles. Strong hands-on experience with: Fortinet Firewalls / FortiGate Palo Alto Firewalls Cisco Catalyst Center / DNA Center Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and network troubleshooting .
